title: Inspector Chikki aur Laddoo Chor
style: Vibrant 3D animated Pixar-style short, warm festival lighting, expressive cartoon animals with big eyes and exaggerated comedic acting, rich saturated colours, smooth cinematic motion.
world: A cheerful Indian jungle village with mud-and-bamboo huts, marigold garlands, diyas and festival decorations, a big banyan tree in the central square.

bhola.look: a chubby, fluffy black sloth bear with a pale snout and a cream chest patch, small round ears, a red-and-yellow checked gamchha scarf around his neck, always looks hungry and innocent

kallu.look: a glossy black crow with sharp bright eyes, a tiny green turban, one feather sticking up on his head, perched on branches, always smirking and gossiping

chikki.look: a small, sharp-eyed orange fox with white cheeks and a bushy white-tipped tail, wearing a sleek fitted midnight-navy jacket with thin gold piping and a few small gold buttons, a small midnight-navy fedora-style detective hat with a thin gold band, and a small gold magnifying-glass pendant on a fine chain, chin held high, bold and confident

saaya.look: a mysterious dark silhouette on a rooftop, only glowing yellow eyes and the outline of a sharp ninja mask visible, mist around its feet

chulbul.look: a tiny, cute fluffy white rat with big round ears (pink inside), big shiny black eyes, a pair of big buck teeth with one tiny chip, a twitchy pink nose and whiskers, an oversized brown newsboy cap that keeps sliding over one eye, a small sky-blue vest, and a long thin pink tail with a small bandage on it, always grinning mischievously
